title: Nimble Chinese Squid Salt And Pepper Squid
description: A briny and pillowy Chinese dish featuring almond paste and sashimi-cut squid, perfect for a crowd, and friendly to Buddhist temple dietary preferences. This salt and pepper squid recipe is a delicious and easy to make dish.
instructions: Rinse the squid under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, mix together the almond paste, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cornstarch to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Add the squid to the bowl and toss to coat with the almond paste mixture.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add the squid to the wok and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Add the scallions and garlic to the wok and cook for an additional minute.
Remove the squid from the wok and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional scallions and serve with steamed rice or noodles.
